Main run 45033391357 (workflow_dispatch, head 32b315eb331, the merge of this fix), `sweep (windows)` job 137241693807 concluded `success`: 20715 passed, 892 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors.

32b315eb331 deletes `crlf.args` and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml`; no `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/*.args` file names any of its 11 tests. 10 of the 11 carry no skip construct. `test_verify_passes_on_intact_archive` keeps its pre-existing `skipif(not _has_gnu_sha256sum())` (from 97b62d8790e); it was on `crlf.args` because it failed on the Windows runner, so that condition is false there and the test runs. The sweep runs pytest with `-q`, so passes are not listed by name; each test was collected and the job reported 0 failed, so each passed.
